sources.title: Use connectors to extend Claude's capabilities
Get started with custom connectors using remote MCP

folds.text: A **connector** lets Claude reach your apps and services, find your data and take actions in them, like searching your files or sending a message.
**MCP**, the Model Context Protocol, is an open standard created by Anthropic for AI apps to connect to tools and data. Think of it as a shared plug shape.
To connect one, browse the connectors directory from a chat or from Customize, then choose Connect and sign in. Switch it on in a chat from the plus menu.
Claude inherits your permissions in each service, so it cannot see what you could not. But connecting lets it read, and possibly change, your data there.
Only connect services you trust and need. Read the permissions at sign-in, turn off tools you do not need, and disconnect services you no longer use.
A **custom connector** points to a remote MCP server. Anthropic does not verify those, so use only servers from organisations you trust.

folds.question: A tool asks for permission to change data in a service you barely use. What is the safest choice?
options: Deny it, or turn that tool off
Connect it and hope for the best
folds.why: Only connect what you trust and need, and be careful with tools that write or change things.
